newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK weather - dry and fine, cloudy later, max 22 C.
newsitem.headline: HK weather - dry and fine, cloudy later, max 22 C.

text.p: It will be dry and fine with haze in the morning, becoming cloudy during the day, the Royal Observatory said on Thursday.
The maximum temperature will be about 22 C with light to moderate to fresh northeasterly winds.
At 7 a.m. the temperature was 20 C and the relative humidity 66 percent.
Outlook for tomorrow: cloudy with a few rain patches. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6441
